title: Typed task control
objective: Add schema-constrained dynamic task admission and authoritative priority, retry, approval, cancellation, process interruption, and native control journaling.
constraints: Treat all downloaded and locally available models as the stack.
Keep the inlet and allowlisted executor authoritative.
Do not grant renderers shell or filesystem mutation authority.
acceptance: Typed task submission creates a repository-bounded queued task.
Priority, retry, approval, and cancellation enforce state and budget rules.
Cancellation interrupts tracked subprocesses and cannot be overwritten by stale queue state.
Native LMEM records accepted controls before mutation.
Python and native TUI controls cross the authenticated inlet boundary.
All automated and live verification passes.
